paths.p0e4/evidence/premium_qc_research_v01_ex: all 13 files; hashes match its SHA256SUMS.txt

findings.title: R2 colour comparison is partly ungraded: C1/C2 CDL never applied to clip 2 (frames 204-334)
evidence: render_premium_qc_local_trials_v01.py:166 applies SetCDL only when clip end > 335 and start <= 694 (R1 SAMPLE); clip 2 [204,335) fails 335>335
rerender_premium_colour_trials_r2.py reuses those same projects and renders 204-563 without re-applying the CDL
COLOUR_R2 contact sheet column 1: mean |row0-row1| = 0.75 and |row0-row2| = 0.76 code values (compression noise), versus about 4.0 in columns 2-3
findings.impact: About 131 of the 360 R2 frames (36%) are identical across C0/C1/C2, so the comparison looks like a grade change in the middle of the clip and is not a fair creative choice.
findings.fix: Re-derive the affected-clip set from the rendered range (or grade all six clips); read back per-clip CDL/node state; re-render R2.

findings.title: Hook is visible during the chain-logo intro: the forbidden intro/hook overlap is back
evidence: line 190: hook Merge1Blend keys (0,0),(fade,1),(78,1),(88,0), so it is visible from frame 1 to 87
base V13 DRP keeps the chain-logo intro on V2 at frames 0-53; aakhri_v12_repair_contract.VISIBILITY_WINDOWS puts the hook at 54-88 and forbids chain_intro/opening_hook overlap
CAPTION_CONTACT_SHEET column 1, all three rows: UN chain emblem drawn on top of 'SOME LOVE STORIES'
findings.impact: Same class of defect as Nitin's V12 overlap complaint, now in every caption treatment.
findings.fix: Start the hook no earlier than frame 54 (or 61 per plan V02); assert against VISIBILITY_WINDOWS with assert_no_forbidden_overlap before rendering.

findings.title: The readback can pass without the patch ever being applied
evidence: line 187/196: ExportFusionComp and ImportFusionComp return values are not checked

line 196: after ImportFusionComp on an existing item, the readback exports comp index 1; comp count and active comp are not asserted (V13 asserted GetFusionCompCount), so index 1 can be the original comp
lines 197-198 only check that the strings 'Montserrat', 'Cinzel' and 'SemiBold' exist, and V13 comps already contain them
findings.impact: readback_sha256 does not prove what was rendered; a failed or appended import passes silently.
findings.fix: Check every API return; assert comp count and active comp; parse the readback and compare Size/Center/RGB/blend keys with the patch.

findings.title: Merges are still picked by name; V13 contract helpers are not reused
evidence: lines 190-195 hard-code Merge1-4 as hook/song-id/title/artist; this is correct for the inherited V11 clip-1 layout, but it is not derived from each Merge's foreground source
set_or_insert (lines 56-64) drops set_or_insert_scalar's duplicate-input rejection and does not import aakhri_v12_repair_contract
clip 2 (204-334) is not patched, so title/artist keep V13 size/colour/curves; frames 0-179 hide this, but applying T* to the full clip changes style at cut 204
findings.fix: Map Merge by foreground source; import the contract helpers; patch clip 2 with continuous keys.

findings.title: Several T sizes are below Nitin's minimum legible sizes, and white is near HDR peak
evidence: Below V09 minimums (hook>=0.09, artist>=0.065): T1 hook 0.088 and artist 0.060; T3 hook 0.078 and artist 0.058. T2 (0.106/0.128/0.072) passes.
off-white (.96,.94,.88) is about 96% of the HLG signal; gold (.847,.722,.314) is roughly the brand sample. No check that the timeline really is HLG
T2 'KINETIC_IMPACT' differs only by a 4-frame fade and larger sizes; the code has no motion
findings.fix: Enforce the V09 test minimums as a gate; bind graphics levels to the timeline colour space; rename T2 or implement the stated motion.

findings.title: CDL goes onto node 1, which also carries the V06 LUT, with no readback
evidence: SetCDL NodeIndex 1 (lines 95-96, 167); the V06 look sits in LUT slot 1 on the same node; CDL-vs-LUT order and colour space are not recorded
no per-clip readback of node/LUT/CDL; C0 equivalence to the V13 master frames is not checked
findings.fix: Put the CDL on a dedicated added serial node after the LUT (or record the processing order); read back and hash the grade state; compare C0 frames with the V13 master frames.

findings.title: Colour reuse trusts files on disk; the cache key is missing
evidence: lines 153-161 reuse any existing .mov+.drp and record affected_clips 'RECORDED_IN_EXISTING_PROJECT', with no check against the prior receipt, script hash or CDL values
R2 script loads projects by name only, with no DRP-hash check

the receipts do not bind renderer/contract sha256, font file hashes, text strings, CDL values, LUT sha, clip properties or render settings; LOCAL_PICKUP_RECEIPT source_commit '4254c5c' is not the reviewed commit 91f4f64, so which code actually ran is unproven
findings.fix: Key reuse on a canonical digest of script+inputs+settings; refuse reuse on mismatch; record the full commit SHA and script hashes in every receipt.

findings.title: The caption comparison ProRes master has no Drive readback
evidence: TECHNICAL_QC lists AAKHRI_PREMIUM_CAPTION_COMPARISON_T1_T2_T3_HLG.mov sha256 b5246b2b...; PERSISTENCE_HANDOFF_V02 contains only its review mp4 and ffprobe json
the R2 'performance_only' label is inaccurate: frames 204-334 include V13 title/artist text (visible in COLOUR_R2 contact sheet column 1)
findings.fix: Persist the master or record why not; relabel R2, or choose a text-free range such as 335-599.

risks: Choosing C1/C2 from R2 now is based on a 64%-graded comparison (PQC-01).
Carrying any T* treatment forward reintroduces the chain-intro collision (PQC-02) and leaves clip-2 style unpatched (PQC-04).
Receipts cannot prove the rendered comps or grade state (PQC-03, PQC-06, PQC-07).
Contact sheets are uncalibrated HDR stills; motion, sync and HDR level were not assessed by this reviewer.
Gemini actual-asset QC is still unverified (AGENT_ROUTE_STATUS).
not_affected_confirmed_by_code: Trials run on isolated clones; BASE_DRP/BASE_MASTER hashes are checked before and after; renders refuse to overwrite; no full master render; publication and deployment flags stay false
recommendation: Do not ask Nitin to choose C/T from these samples until PQC-01 and PQC-02 are fixed and re-rendered; PQC-03 is the minimum provenance fix before re-rendering.
